items.title: Maruti, Tata lead hatchback revival as India's carmakers rediscover the mass market
items.summary: Indian carmakers are rediscovering the hatchback. For years, SUVs dominated sales. Now, rising prices and economic challenges mean small cars are key for growth. Companies like Maruti Suzuki and Tata Motors are investing in new, feature-rich hatchbacks. This strategy aims to attract first-time buyers and expand the market.

items.title: Nissan inks deal to make Chery's UK vehicles at Sunderland facility
items.summary: Japanese automaker Nissan has struck a deal with Chinese manufacturer Chery. Nissan will produce Chery's UK passenger cars at its Sunderland factory. This partnership aims to boost Chery's European presence and avoid import duties. The move is part of Nissan's strategy to optimize its plant usage and cut costs.

items.summary: The acquisition expands RSB's footprint in the automotive components sector and adds clutch systems to its portfolio of drivetrain products.

items.summary: The statement follows reports that Tata Motors may use a Freelander-linked platform from a Chery–Jaguar Land Rover joint venture for its Avinya EVs.

items.title: Tata Motors rethinks its premium EV playbook
items.summary: Tata Motors has revamped its premium EV brand, Avinya, by shifting from its original platform plans to leveraging partnerships and ready-made architectures. This strategic pivot aims to accelerate the launch of its luxury EVs, with the first model slated for a 2027 India rollout, utilizing the Freelander platform from Chery Jaguar Land Rover.

items.title: Tata Motors turns to Chery platform for Avinya EVs after JLR roadmap setback
items.summary: The first Avinya model based on Chery's platform is expected to be launched in 2027, with a second model planned for 2029.

items.title: Hyundai to make Tamil Nadu its EV hub, targets 90% localisation by 2032
items.summary: The automaker said it plans to launch two new models from its Chennai plant this year, including its first mass-market dedicated EV.

items.summary: The company has additionally introduced a wireless charger and tyre pressure monitoring system (TPMS) to improve convenience and safety.

items.title: Tyre Makers Walk Tightrope In FY27 As Demand Holds Firm, But Costs Surge
items.summary: India’s tyre makers are entering FY27 with strong demand visibility, high plant utilisation and a fresh capex cycle. But they are also facing one of the sharpest input cost shocks in recent quarters, triggered by the West Asia crisis, crude-linked raw material volatility, higher natural rubber prices, rupee depreciation and rising logistics costs.

items.title: TVS Srichakra Approves Rs 220 Crore Capex for Capacity Expansion at Madurai Plants
items.summary: The board of directors of TVS Srichakra Limited has approved a capital investment of up to Rs 220 crore to expand production capacities at its manufacturing facilities located in Vellaripatti, Madurai. The decision was finalized during a board meeting on May 27, 2026, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges.

items.title: Motherson commissions 15 MW captive solar plant in UP
items.summary: The project will generate 23.4 GWh of renewable power annually and cut carbon emissions by around 17,000 tonnes a year.

items.title: Napino Auto and Electronics Appoints Vikrant Sharma as Dual Chief Business and Strategy Head
items.summary: Napino Auto and Electronics Limited has appointed Vikrant Sharma as its new Chief Business Officer and Group Chief Strategy Officer. The executive transitions to the manufacturing enterprise to lead dual corporate mandates focused on scaling long-term industrial operations and steering next-generation commercial frameworks.

items.title: LOHUM Secures Rights to Upgrades and Restart Hindustan Copper's Gujarat Plant
items.summary: Hindustan Copper Limited has awarded critical minerals producer LOHUM the operational rights to restart, upgrade, and maintain its defunct copper refining project in Jhagadia, Gujarat. The public-private partnership will function under a 20-year revenue-sharing contract, which includes an option for a five-year extension.

items.title: Govt set to roll out ₹3,000-crore incentive scheme for lithium, nickel processing to boost EV supply chain
items.summary: To qualify for the proposed incentives, lithium processing facilities are expected to require a minimum annual capacity of 30,000 metric tonnes, while nickel processing plants would need a minimum capacity of 50,000 metric tonnes.

items.title: PMO to examine battery PLI scheme amid SEBI allegations on Rajesh Exports
items.summary: In its interim order, SEBI has alleged that ACC Energy Storage Pvt Ltd was set up in 2022 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Rajesh Exports Limited and was used as a vehicle for non-transparent related-party transactions and the diversion of company funds.

items.title: Clean rules put auto parts cos on a whole new growth path
items.summary: Even as geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions create near-term volatility, industry executives said the regulatory cycle—spanning fuel efficiency, emissions, safety and electrification—is broader than earlier ones and is expected to increase the value of components fitted in every vehicle.
